about: Roger Wilco Imagery — Ottawa Watch baseline imagery. Clear Sentinel-2 quicklooks (JPEG + georeference sidecar) per place, from RWI's baseline backfill. Images are in baselines/<site>/. Same record shape as the RWI pipeline's data/baseline-imagery/index.json.
attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026, processed by Roger Wilco Imagery
